meta.description: All Regex/Pattern literals for processing (Regex(...) and .toRegex) across pennywiseai-tracker - excludes build/node_modules/kubera/ALL_REGEX inventory files and settings.gradle.kts

properties.pattern: raw regex pattern string inside quotes (without delimiters)
properties.options: second arg to Regex() or arg to toRegex(), e.g. RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE
properties.bank: bank display name from getBankName() (e.g. 'HDFC Bank'), null for non-bank parsers
properties.country: country from docs/supported-banks.json, null if not mapped

fixesApplied: BankParser.kt bank set to null (was incorrectly 'for')
SharedCategoryMapping dynamic regex corrected to template \b${keyword}\b and marked DYNAMIC
Currency now only for amount/balance or when pattern explicitly contains currency token (was over-assigned to 1293 non-amount regexes)
Count validated: 1830 literal processing regexes (rg 1835 includes 5 dynamic constructions)
knownLimitations: 17 amount entries have no numeric token (e.g. (?i)Amt:\s*NGN) - they are prefixes used with separate amount capture
Category is heuristic (pattern + lineContent keywords) - 59 other category may include uncategorized processing regexes
validation.fileCoverage: 169/170 rg files (1 missing is RuleEngine dynamic, correctly excluded)
